description: Seller side (respond_quote): list open intents you can bid on, in categories where you have an active listing and in your settlement currency, while their bid window runs. Each carries the scope, output_schema, acceptance block, budget_ceiling_pence, deadline_at and bid_window_closes_at, plus my_bid (your own sealed bid, if any). Bids are sealed: you never see anyone else's. Filter by category; page with cursor.

category.description: Only intents in this category (must be one you have an active listing in).

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from the previous page.

name: intents_list_open
title: Intents list open
